passageTitle: Questions 147–148 refer to the following ticket.
passageHtml:
GRAND ART MUSEUM — EXHIBITION TICKET

Event: Modern City Photography

Date: Saturday, July 18

Entry Time: 2:00 P.M.

Hall: East Wing, Room 204

Admission Price: $12.00 (Adult)

* Please arrive 15 minutes before your entry time. Large bags and umbrellas must be left at the cloakroom on the first floor. No flash photography is allowed inside the gallery.

questions.q: Where is the photography exhibition held?
questions.translation: Triển lãm nhiếp ảnh được tổ chức ở đâu?
questions.explanation: Trên vé ghi rõ mục Hall: East Wing, Room 204.

questions.q: What are visitors NOT allowed to do in the gallery?
questions.translation: Khách tham quan KHÔNG được phép làm gì trong phòng trưng bày?
questions.explanation: Dòng cuối ghi 'No flash photography is allowed inside the gallery' (Không được phép chụp ảnh có đèn flash).

passageTitle: Questions 149–151 refer to the following text message chain.
passageHtml:
Min-ji (11:15 A.M.): Hi Tom, do you have plans for lunch today?

Tom (11:17 A.M.): Not yet. I am finishing a report right now, so I will be free around 12:15 P.M.

Min-ji (11:18 A.M.): Great! A new noodle shop just opened across from our office building. Would you like to try it?

Tom (11:20 A.M.): Sure! I heard their beef noodles are delicious. Let's meet in the lobby at 12:20 P.M.

Min-ji (11:21 A.M.): Sounds good. See you then!

questions.q: What is Tom doing at 11:17 A.M.?
questions.translation: Tom đang làm gì lúc 11:17 sáng?
questions.explanation: Tom nhắn lúc 11:17 A.M.: 'I am finishing a report right now'.

questions.q: Where is the new noodle shop located?
questions.translation: Quán mì mới nằm ở đâu?
questions.explanation: Min-ji nói: 'A new noodle shop just opened across from our office building' (đối diện tòa nhà văn phòng).

questions.q: When will Min-ji and Tom meet?
questions.translation: Khi nào Min-ji và Tom sẽ gặp nhau?
questions.explanation: Tom hẹn: 'Let's meet in the lobby at 12:20 P.M.' và Min-ji đồng ý.

passageTitle: Questions 152–154 refer to the following notice.
passageHtml:
ELEVATOR MAINTENANCE NOTICE

Please be advised that Elevator B in the Oakwood Building will be out of service for routine maintenance on Tuesday, August 4, from 9:00 A.M. to 3:00 P.M.

During these hours, please use Elevator A or the stairs near the main entrance. Elevator B will operate normally again after 3:00 P.M.

We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your patience.
— Building Management

questions.q: Why will Elevator B be closed on August 4?
questions.translation: Tại sao thang máy B sẽ đóng cửa vào ngày 4 tháng 8?
questions.explanation: Thông báo nêu rõ: 'Elevator B... will be out of service for routine maintenance'.

questions.q: How long will the maintenance work last?
questions.translation: Công việc bảo trì sẽ kéo dài bao lâu?
questions.explanation: Từ 9:00 A.M. đến 3:00 P.M. (15:00) là 6 tiếng đồng hồ.

questions.q: What are people asked to use instead of Elevator B?
questions.translation: Mọi người được yêu cầu sử dụng gì thay cho thang máy B?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 hướng dẫn: 'please use Elevator A or the stairs near the main entrance'.

passageTitle: Questions 155–157 refer to the following menu.
passageHtml:
SUNRISE CAFE — MORNING SPECIALS

Served Daily from 7:00 A.M. to 11:00 A.M.

  • Americano (Hot or Iced): $3.00
  • Green Tea Latte: $4.50
  • Ham & Cheese Sandwich: $5.50
  • Fresh Fruit Bowl: $4.00

* Morning Combo: Order any drink with a sandwich and save $1.00! Free Wi-Fi is available for all customers.

questions.q: When are the Morning Specials available?
questions.translation: Các món đặc biệt buổi sáng được phục vụ khi nào?
questions.explanation: Dòng phụ đề ghi: 'Served Daily from 7:00 A.M. to 11:00 A.M.'.

questions.q: Which item is the most expensive on the menu?
questions.translation: Món nào đắt nhất trong thực đơn?
questions.explanation: Ham & Cheese Sandwich có giá $5.50, cao nhất trong 4 món.

questions.q: How much does a customer pay for an Americano and a Ham & Cheese Sandwich together?
questions.translation: Khách hàng phải trả bao nhiêu cho một ly Americano và một bánh mì kẹp thịt nguội phô mai?
questions.explanation: Americano ($3.00) + Sandwich ($5.50) = $8.50. Áp dụng Morning Combo được giảm $1.00, còn $7.50.

questions.q: What time does Bus #02 leave Central Park?
questions.translation: Xe buýt số 02 rời Công viên Trung tâm lúc mấy giờ?
questions.explanation: Theo bảng, ở hàng Bus #02, cột Central Park ghi 7:50 A.M.

passageTitle: Questions 161–163 refer to the following job advertisement.
passageHtml:
HELP WANTED — SALES ASSOCIATE

Green Leaf Clothing Store is looking for a friendly, part-time Sales Associate to join our downtown shop. Responsibilities include helping customers find clothing sizes, folding shirts, and working at the cash register.

Work Hours: Saturdays and Sundays, 10:00 A.M. – 6:00 P.M.
Pay: $16 per hour, plus a 20% employee discount on all store items.

No previous retail experience is required. Interested applicants should send a short résumé to jobs@greenleafshop.com by May 25.

questions.q: What position is Green Leaf Clothing Store hiring for?
questions.translation: Cửa hàng quần áo Green Leaf đang tuyển vị trí nào?
questions.explanation: Tiêu đề ghi rõ 'HELP WANTED — SALES ASSOCIATE' (nhân viên bán hàng).

questions.q: When will the new employee work?
questions.translation: Nhân viên mới sẽ làm việc khi nào?
questions.explanation: Mục Work Hours ghi: 'Saturdays and Sundays, 10:00 A.M. – 6:00 P.M.'.

questions.q: How can interested people apply for the job?
options: By visiting the shop in person
By sending a résumé via e-mail
By filling out a paper form
questions.translation: Những người quan tâm có thể ứng tuyển bằng cách nào?
questions.explanation: Câu cuối hướng dẫn: 'send a short résumé to jobs@greenleafshop.com by May 25'.

passageTitle: Questions 164–166 refer to the following instructions.
passageHtml:
HOW TO GET A WESTTOWN LIBRARY CARD

  1. Bring a photo ID (such as a driver's license or passport) and proof of your home address.
  2. Visit the Information Desk on the first floor and fill out a short application form.
  3. A librarian will check your documents and take a quick photo for your card.
  4. Your library card will be ready in five minutes!

With your card, you can borrow up to 10 books for two weeks at no cost. Books can be returned to the drop box outside the main door 24 hours a day.

questions.q: What must applicants bring to get a library card?
options: A photo ID and proof of address
questions.translation: Người đăng ký phải mang theo gì để làm thẻ thư viện?
questions.explanation: Bước 1 ghi: 'Bring a photo ID... and proof of your home address'.
vocab: bằng chứng, giấy tờ chứng minh

questions.q: How long does it take to receive the card after applying?
questions.translation: Mất bao lâu để nhận thẻ sau khi đăng ký?
questions.explanation: Bước 4 ghi: 'Your library card will be ready in five minutes!'.

questions.q: How many books can a cardholder borrow at one time?
questions.translation: Người có thẻ có thể mượn tối đa bao nhiêu cuốn sách cùng lúc?
questions.explanation: Đoạn cuối ghi: 'you can borrow up to 10 books for two weeks'.

passageTitle: Questions 167–169 refer to the following receipt.
passageHtml:

questions.q: How did the customer pay for the items?

passageTitle: Questions 170–172 refer to the following invitation.
passageHtml:
YOU ARE INVITED TO OUR YEAR-END DINNER PARTY!

Dear Apex Marketing Team,

To celebrate a successful year, our company is hosting a dinner party for all employees and one guest each.

Date: Friday, December 19
Time: 6:30 P.M. – 10:00 P.M.
Place: Blue Sky Hotel, Grand Ballroom

There will be a buffet dinner, live music, and a lucky draw with great prizes! Please reply to Helen at helen@apexmkt.com by December 10 to let us know if you will attend and whether you are bringing a guest.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the event?
questions.translation: Mục đích của sự kiện là gì?
questions.explanation: Đoạn đầu viết: 'To celebrate a successful year, our company is hosting a dinner party...'.

questions.q: Who can each employee bring to the party?
questions.translation: Mỗi nhân viên có thể dẫn theo ai đến bữa tiệc?
questions.explanation: Thư mời ghi: 'for all employees and one guest each'.

questions.q: What should employees do by December 10?
questions.translation: Nhân viên nên làm gì trước ngày 10 tháng 12?
questions.explanation: Câu cuối yêu cầu: 'Please reply to Helen at helen@apexmkt.com by December 10 to let us know if you will attend...'.
